subject: gk
question: Mention one limitation of the operation of the supermarket.

options.text: A large amount of capital is required to start and run a supermarket.
A customer can get goods of different brands at one place.
They handle a wide range of goods.

solution:
The correct answer is __**a large amount of capital is required to start and run a super market.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Super markets **require a **large amount of capital **to start and run their operations. 
 
• This is due to the high costs involved in **leasing or purchasing** a large retail space, stocking inventory, and hiring employees. 
 
• Additionally, super markets need to invest in **marketing and advertising** to attract customers and stay competitive in the market. 
 
• However, once established, super markets can generate **significant revenue and profits** due to their wide range of products and convenience for customers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Super markets are** large retail stores** that offer a wide range of products to customers under one roof.
 
• These products can range from **groceries, household items, electronics, clothing, **and more.
 
• Super markets are known for their convenience, as customers can **find everything** they need in one place.
 
• They also offer **competitive pricing and promotions** to attract customers and increase sales.
